name: @thirdlight/effects
description: Thirdlight phase 20.1: the CPU reference semantics of visual-effect graphs (content.effects, graph kind `effect`) — a deterministic-per-seed particle evaluator over typed arrays (spawn, initialize, update, kill, events between systems) plus the output helpers (flipbook frames, billboard axes, light selection, trails). Visual only: never part of the deterministic game simulation. Runtime-safe and pure: no three.js, no Node built-ins, no I/O (imports @thirdlight/project-model only).
